verdict.rationale: EFTPS is a Treasury-operated federal tax payment rail that moves funds into the government's own settlement system, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of service. The downloadable Batch Provider Software is a client-side submission tool, not a self-hostable instance of the core system, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
